annotations.title: Luxury packing list generator: yacht, safari, ski, cruise and beach

description: Returns a packing checklist grouped into documents and money, clothing, footwear, toiletries, tech, health, activities, trip-type extras and children, with per-person quantities scaled to the nights and laundry (a planning choice). Trip types can be combined. Includes sourced UK cabin liquids rules and an example light-aircraft safari luggage limit. General guidance: no entry, visa or health advice; check airline and operator rules. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/luxury-packing-list
